entities.summary: Patricia Ann Baird, is a British medical geneticist active in Canada. Her research has specialized on the relationship between medical technology and ethics. Patricia Baird was a naturalists & biologists from Lytham St Annes (b. 1939-10-11, Lytham St Annes). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to environmental history.
